description: This PHP script tests integration with the Bugzilla issue tracker via XML-RPC interface. It sets up configuration, instantiates the interface class, and conducts existence checks on specific bug IDs, also contains commented-out code for additional bug tracking operations.

classes.name: bugzillaxmlrpcInterface
classes.description: A class for interfacing with Bugzilla via XML-RPC to perform bug tracking operations

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks whether a specific bug ID exists in the Bugzilla tracker
